id_lightning_bolt_wall.blurb: Lightning Bolt Wall is one of three walls in the Funny Business area at Massacre Rocks, a basalt sport-climbing zone on the Snake River plain near American Falls. Of its ten climbs, nine are bolted lines, mostly around 5.9 and 5.10 with a single 5.11, and there is one V4 boulder problem. The wall is a dark brown face that looks southeast and catches sunshine through most of a winter afternoon, which makes it a good cool-season pick. Summer afternoons here run very hot, so aim for early or late sessions. It sits a short stroll below the rim and close to its two neighbouring walls.

id_window_rock_west.blurb: The west side of Window Rock in City of Rocks, southern Idaho, is the demanding half of the formation; the other side is a low-angle slab that novices like. Ten routes here split evenly between bolted lines and gear routes. Apart from one easy 5.5, they cluster around 5.11, with a handful of 5.12s and a single 5.13, so it is best for climbers already comfortable on hard granite. Several lines carry three-star reputations. The rock lies just north of Parking Lot Rock, a short trail walk from the lot, which keeps the day relaxed.
